quarterly_data.signal: LS Marine Solution (release on LS Cable & System's newsroom about its Q3 2026 results, whose numbers the DART preliminary filing already states): the more than threefold year-on-year rise in Q3 operating profit came from overseas expansion and construction efficiency, with Taiwan Power Company's offshore wind farm submarine-cable burial (TPC2) and Asia-Pacific submarine telecom-cable installation projects contributing, and subsidiary LS BuildWin improving profitability through construction efficiency on submarine and underground cable work in Asia and the Middle East. The 4.3% revenue decline reflects GL2030 being unavailable for projects during its expansion work; GL2030 enters full service starting with the Malaysia project in October and is expected to contribute to revenue growth. The release expects further orders and revenue growth as the Sinan Ui and Taean offshore wind projects proceed in turn and the West Coast HVDC energy highway project gets fully under way.
